description:
Keane Mahony Smith are delighted to offer to the market an exquisite residential property in the heart of Galway City Centre. No. 6 Connolly Terrace has been extensively renovated to its current state of luxury providing a fabulous living haven just 500m from Eyre Square. Beautifully refurbished to combine modern comfort and style in a unique layout, this property offers an array of potential uses.

Connolly Terrace fronts onto Bohermore Road, one of Galway City’s most established residential roads charmingly characterised by its traditional 2-up 2-down terraces. 

6 Connolly Terrace is an end of terrace, two-storey property, originally constructed in 1934 and since upgraded to the highest of modern standards to provide the perfect city centre lifestyle. The property comprises 125 sq. metres – reception room, 2 kitchens, 6 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms and has electric and hot air heating systems throughout. The house has extensive electrical connections with most rooms having recessed spotlights.
Set back from the main road, the property is fronted by a large cobble-lock driveway with landscaped flower beds and a southerly rear aspect. The property is of concrete construction with pitched tiled roof and double-glazed PVC windows and doors throughout. There is hollow core concrete flooring in the extension. The ground floor of the property has wall mounted air conditioning units serving the living/kitchen and humidity controlled mechanical extraction serving the bathrooms and upper floor areas.  The property has mira electric and power showers supplied through 3 independently controlled hot water cylinders.There is LED lighting throughout with dual-side bedside light controls in each bedroom.

Accommodation:
The entrance leads to the open-plan kitchen/living space with fully-fitted kitchen, integrated appliances, recessed lighting and tiled flooring. The living room has an attractive fireplace and a raised timber floor.  There is a separate kitchen and downstairs wc, and 2 bedrooms with French doors leading to the rear garden.

The central hallway features a very thoughtful under-stairs laundry unit and solid timber stairs to the first floor. 

The solid timber stairs leads to 4 generous double bedrooms, 3 with fitted wardrobes, timber flooring and 2 fully-tiled ensuites with bath, whb & wc.  2 of the bedrooms have also French doors with rear south facing balconies.  There are also 2 separate bathrooms which are fully tiled. 

Exceptional Flexibility:
No. 6 Connolly Terrace offers exceptional flexibility and is an excellent investment opportunity with a wealth of demand for long- and short- term lettings in the area. For owner occupiers, the Rent-A-Room scheme would be very suitable here due to the property’s size.

The property has parking for 3 cars to the front and is not overlooked from the rear.  There is a rear entrance and 2 storage sheds also.

This house is in showhouse condition and offers exceptional flexibility and is an excellent investment opportunity with a wealth of demand for long and short term lettings in the area.   This house is vacant for over 2 years so therefore no rent capp is applicable. Families would be perfectly accommodated in this spacious home with distinct living areas and spacious rooms.

We highly recommend viewing this property with the selling agent to truly appreciate its features.
